item.title: Person found dead in fiery, single-car crash Sunday morning in Huntley, authorities say
item.description: A person was found dead in a fiery, single-car crash Sunday morning in northwest suburban Huntley, according to authorities.

item.title: Weekend Break: The astonishing Spinosaurus arrives at the Chicago Children's Museum
item.description: CHICAGO (WGN) — A colossal discovery in the world of dinosaurs is now on display right here in Chicago. The Spinosaurus mirabilis, or astonishing Spinosaurus (as it is more commonly referred to), was put on display at the Chicago Children's Museum as a part of Dr. Paul Sereno's Dinosaur Expedition exhibit this time last week. item.title: Two shot during fight at CTA Red Line station on Chicago’s South Side
item.description: Two men were shot at a CTA Red Line station in Chicago early Sunday morning, and three men were taken into custody with charges pending.

item.title: Saks Fifth Avenue leaving Chicago’s Magnificent Mile amid company restructuring
item.description: Saks Fifth Avenue is preparing to close its iconic store on the Magnificent Mile in downtown Chicago.

item.title: Chicago dance students attacked with liquid outside studio in alleged racist incident
item.description: A group of Ballet Folklorico de Chicago dancers experienced physical aggression from neighbors who threw an unknown liquid at them while making threats, leading the studio to plan to file a protective order and press charges.

item.title: Siamsa Na Ngael and Old St. Pat's Church highlight St. Patrick's Day celebrations to come in Chicago
item.description: Chicagoans will celebrate St. Patrick's Day with the annual dying of the Chicago River green, the St. Patrick's Day Parade, the Civic Mass, and the Shamrock'n Festival at Old St. Pat's Church, which is celebrating its 180th anniversary.

item.title: Monday forecast: Near-record warmth and sunny skies
item.description: After mild temps overnight, with lows only in the mid-40s, Chicagoland will see abundant sunshine and unseasonable warmth — perhaps even record warmth.

item.title: Iran names Mojtaba Khamenei to succeed his slain father as supreme leader
item.description: Mojtaba Khamenei, the son of Iran's late supreme leader, has been named his successor, Iranian state TV announced early Monday, as the war that began with his father's killing less than two weeks ago took a dramatic turn.

item.title: Condo complex in Morton Grove evacuated after floor partially collapses in one of its units, according to officials
item.description: A condo complex in north suburban Morton Grove was evacuated Saturday night after a floor partially collapsed in one of its units, according to officials.

item.title: 'Terrifying': Family says Evanston-born U.S. citizen detained for hours after returning to O'Hare
item.description: Sunny Naqvi, a U.S. citizen, was detained by U.S. Customs and Border Patrol at O'Hare International Airport for nearly 30 hours with no cause, leading to a protest outside the ICE facility in Broadview, where her family and community activists demanded answers.
